primary_metric: pneumonia test AUROC, mean over three seeds
bootstrap_unit: exact-image-hash clusters in test, plus resampled paired training seeds
inference_benchmark: same seed42 weights; three interleaved FP32/AMP rounds at batch1; 30 warmups and 200 timed forwards each
